svg.text: The RF does not notice the pins
Received spectrum at 61.44 MSPS, TX1 at full power into a 50 dB loop. Blue: pins toggling at up to 30.72
The traces overlap almost everywhere, and nothing rises above the floor at the pin frequencies. The spurs beside the
tone are the radio's own (its image and harmonics): they are there with the pins off too, hidden under the blue.
